post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I performed well in controlling the pace of missions and making quick decisions when leading, but could improve on adapting to dynamic role-reveals and changing player loyalties.

player_observations.Bob: Bob (who I later found out was Merlin) consistently demonstrated solid leadership skills and a good understanding of the game mechanics, but was overly trusting of his teammates.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie, a fellow Good player, often went rogue and seemed to prioritize her own goals over the team's objectives, which put a significant strain on our overall mission success.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's (later revealed as Assassin) playstyle was quite straightforward, often focusing on her own success and contributing to our team's downfall through her actions.
player_observations.Eve: Eve (our enemy player) skillfully executed her team's plans, utilizing her abilities to disrupt our missions and ultimately contributing to our failure.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I could improve on trusting my instincts and making more decisive judgments, especially when it came to revealing my identity to the players. I did well in staying under the radar as a spy but should have been more proactive in uncovering the traitor.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was a careful player who seemed to be aware of the good team's strengths but struggled to make key decisions when it counted.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie consistently demonstrated good strategic thinking and was able to stay hidden for a significant portion of the game. Their ultimate downfall was getting too confident and taking unnecessary risks.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played stealthily as the Assassin, and her true allegiance was only revealed at the end. However, she made some avoidable mistakes that ultimately led to her capture.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played her role as an Evil Player perfectly, taking calculated risks to stay hidden and influencing crucial missions to the evil team's advantage. She had a good sense of timing and exploited her opponents' weaknesses effectively.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As a good player, I was overly trusting of my teammates, especially since I knew my role, which may have led to my downfall. I should have been more vigilant and questioned the loyalty of my teammates. Improving communication would have greatly enhanced my performance in this game.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played well in her role as a good player, demonstrating strong leadership and decisiveness which likely contributed to the success of the first mission.
player_observations.Bob(Merlin): I was misled by Bob's seemingly cooperative actions, which made it difficult for me to suspect his true nature as Merlin. His ability to hide in plain sight was impressive.
player_observations.Charlie(Myself): As I've mentioned earlier, I was too trusting, but that's only because I know my own role. If I were playing in the dark, I would have been much more alert and cautious.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's actions were inconsistent, making it hard to determine her true role. She seemed to be working against me in Mission 3 but her participation in Mission 4 was puzzling.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a masterful evil role, making strategic moves that pushed me and my teammates into vulnerable positions. Her ability to influence decisions and create divisions within our team was impressive.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully executed my role as the Assassin, eliminating key targets, but I could improve by being more selective with my targets to minimize exposure.

player_observations.Alice: She consistently played conservatively, prioritizing her own survival over potentially eliminating other players, which made her seem predictable.
player_observations.Bob: As Merlin, he performed admirably, guiding his team effectively and making crucial decisions to advance the evil cause, but his failure to eliminate key targets hindered his team in the end.
player_observations.Charlie: He had a tendency to rush into situations without properly assessing the risks, which made him vulnerable to elimination by the Assassin.
player_observations.Eve: She played her role effectively, working closely with me as the Assassin to execute key missions and eliminating threats when necessary.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I executed my role effectively, influencing and sabotaging the opposition to achieve our win. My ability to blend in and remain undetected was key to my performance. However, I could have been more proactive in the later missions.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played quite conservatively, sticking to her role as a loyal servant and trusting her team to make key decisions.
